judge_context: All crypto belongs in the new encryption package (stream writer/reader, Config.Validate, LoadKey) using stdlib crypto/aes, crypto/cipher, crypto/hmac and the already-vendored golang.org/x/crypto/pbkdf2 - no new module. The handler should compose io.Writers (dump -> gzip -> encrypt -> MultiWriter/pipes to storages) in storageReadWriteCloser and load/validate the key before creating storages; callers of the changed fileutil signatures (storage backends and their tests) must be updated rather than wrapped. Errors should be wrapped with %w and sentinel ErrInvalidKey, matching the repo style.

case_items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
case_items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
case_items.question: Apart from the mandated changes (EnsureFileSuffix/EnsureFileName gaining shouldEncrypt before unique, Job.validate exported as Validate, storageReadWriteCloser gaining an encryptor parameter, new Job.Encryption field), are existing exported signatures, config YAML keys and the unencrypted dump output unchanged, with all existing call sites (storage backends, handler, tests) updated consistently?

criteria.perfect: Only mandated signature changes; every caller updated; unencrypted jobs produce byte-identical output and filenames as before.
criteria.accept: Mandated changes done, plus a minor extra exported change or a caller updated in an awkward but working way.
criteria.bad: Breaks unrelated exported APIs/config keys, leaves callers uncompiled, or changes unencrypted output.
